name: Long March 2D
location_str: Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: The 54th launch of the year for China's CASC, 624th all time. That is a launch every six days. No Long March 2D has failed in 69 flights. Worldwide, it is attempt number 264 of the year.
slot_b_text: Liquid hydrogen fuel is so cold (-423°F) that it would instantly freeze air into a solid block of nitrogen ice.
